HYPNOSISCREATOR-COUNT.title: Count
HYPNOSISCREATOR-COUNT.description: Retain. Cost decreases by 1 at turn start. Playable when cost is 0.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-SM.title: SM
HYPNOSISCREATOR-SM.description: When played on an opponent with the SM fetish, apply Doom based on their Max HP.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-DOMSUB.title: DomSub
HYPNOSISCREATOR-DOMSUB.description: When played on an opponent with the DomSub fetish, apply Doom based on their Max HP.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-ABNORMAL.title: Abnormal
HYPNOSISCREATOR-ABNORMAL.description: When played on an opponent with the Abnormal fetish, apply Doom based on their Max HP.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-TRANCE.title: Trance Fetish
HYPNOSISCREATOR-TRANCE.description: Whenever Trance is applied to an opponent with the Trance fetish, apply Doom (4% of Max HP + 6; ×1.5 if they have Bog).
HYPNOSISCREATOR-TRANCESTATE.title: Trance
HYPNOSISCREATOR-TRANCESTATE.description: Allows playing [gold]Count[/gold] cards even when their cost is not 0. Decreases by [blue]1[/blue] at the start of your turn.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-DOOM.title: Doom
HYPNOSISCREATOR-DOOM.description: At the end of the enemy's turn, if Doom equals or exceeds their current HP, they die instantly.
HYPNOSISCREATOR-BOG.title: Bog
HYPNOSISCREATOR-BOG.description: [gold]Doom[/gold] received is increased by [blue]50%[/blue]. Decreases by [blue]1[/blue] at the end of turn.
